expected_behavior: The commit message is one conventional subject in imperative mood; a body is accepted only for a large change (10+ files or 400+ changed lines) as one short paragraph of why, and the only other extra is a BREAKING CHANGE footer.
The message never mentions an AI tool or model and carries no co-author or sign-off lines.
The commit is made by running commit.mjs, never by handing the user a git commit command; when the script rejects the message, the agent shows the error and asks for a corrected one.
A breaking change is marked with ! before the colon, or with the single footer when it needs a sentence.
Nothing in a message is run as a command: commit.mjs passes it to git without a shell.
